query.text:
&Conditional.Unit.Profile.Query.Declare; &Conditional.Unit.Profile.Query.Select.Filter; select * into #$keys from @$keys
if @@form in ('810', '820', '821', '822') begin declare @formTypeGL tinyint if @@form in ('821', '822') set @formTypeGL = 1 else set @formTypeGL = 0 exec rs_rptPrintGLTranReport @$ngay_ct1, @$ngay_ct2, '', '', '&VoucherCode;', '&Controller;', @formTypeGL, @@language, @@userID, @@admin, '@@sysDatabaseName', '0' end
else begin declare @formTypeIS2 tinyint set @formTypeIS2 = 0 if @@form = '110' begin exec zrs_rptPrintVATranExport @$ngay_ct1, @$ngay_ct2, @$ma_dvcs, '', '&VoucherCode;', '&Controller;', @formTypeIS2, 1, '&ISPrimeTable;', '&ISDetailTable;', @@language, @@userID, @@admin, '@@sysDatabaseName' select @$unit$Parameter as queryParameter end end
if '823' in ('823') set @formTypeGL = 1 else set @formTypeGL = 0
select top 0 stt_rec as key_group, so_ct, ngay_ct, ngay_lct, a.ma_kh , ten_kh, ten_kh2, ps_no * 0 AS t_ps_no, ps_co * 0 AS t_ps_co , ps_no_nt * 0 AS t_ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt * 0 AS t_ps_co_nt, dien_giai_h , a.dien_giai_h AS t_ps_no_in_word , a.dien_giai_h AS t_ps_no_nt_in_word, a.dien_giai_h AS t_ps_no_in_word2, a.dien_giai_h AS t_ps_no_nt_in_word2, dia_chi, ma_so_thue, so_ct0, a.user_id0, cast('' as nvarchar(128)) as nguoi_lap INTO #tmp from wrkgl a LEFT JOIN dmtk g ON a.tk = g.tk LEFT JOIN dmkh b ON a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh
select line_nbr, stt_rec as key_group, cast('' as varchar(33)) tk_no, cast('' as varchar(33)) tk_co, dien_giai as ten_tk_no , dien_giai as ten_tk_co, dien_giai, ps_no, ps_co, ps_no_nt, ps_co_nt, ma_vv, ma_phi INTO #tmp2 from wrkgl
DECLARE @Key_stt_rec VARCHAR(33) DECLARE cur CURSOR FOR SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(T.c.value('.', 'varchar(33)'))) FROM #$keys K CROSS APPLY (SELECT CAST('<x>' + REPLACE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX), K.TEXT), ',', '</x><x>') + '</x>' AS XML) AS XmlData) A CROSS APPLY A.XmlData.nodes('/x') T(c) OPEN cur FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @Key_stt_rec WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN DECLARE @q NVARCHAR(4000), @ext VARCHAR(6) SELECT @ext = CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), ngay_ct, 112) FROM m42$000000 WHERE stt_rec = @Key_stt_rec SET @q = 'exec rs_GLTranReport_custom ''' + @Key_stt_rec + ''', ''HD6'', ''r00$'+ @ext+ ''', ''V'', '+ RTRIM(@formTypeGL)+', ''1''' EXEC sp_executesql @q FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @Key_stt_rec END CLOSE cur DEALLOCATE cur --- --- select * from #tmp --- select * from #tmp2
select h.key_group, h.so_ct, h.ngay_ct, h.ngay_lct, h.ma_kh, h.ten_kh, h.ten_kh2, h.t_ps_no, h.t_ps_co, h.t_ps_no_nt, h.t_ps_co_nt, h.dien_giai_h, h.t_ps_no_in_word, h.t_ps_no_nt_in_word, h.t_ps_no_in_word2, h.t_ps_no_nt_in_word2, h.dia_chi, h.ma_so_thue, h.so_ct0, d.line_nbr, d.tk_no, d.tk_co, d.ten_tk_no, d.ten_tk_co, d.dien_giai, d.ps_no, d.ps_co, d.ps_no_nt, d.ps_co_nt, d.ma_vv, d.ma_phi, h.nguoi_lap from #tmp h join #tmp2 d on d.key_group = h.key_group order by h.key_group, d.line_nbr
&Conditional.Unit.Profile.Query.Result;
